name: Donald Norcross
page_title: Donald Norcross' Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (NJ) - District 1

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "I voted to codify #RoeVWade and I am demanding the Senate to do the same. They can solidify Roe and make sure every American woman, regardless of where they live in our country, has access to reproductive medical care"

"This is not a drill. 26 states could move to ban women’s access to reproductive health care if Roe v. Wade is overturned, affecting 36 million women — nearly half of the women age 18-49 in the US. We must protect the freedom of women to make reproductive health decisions."
"Today marks the 47th anniversary of Roe v. Wade — A reminder that we must continue to fight to ensure women can control choices regarding their bodies & have access to care. "

"Women’s reproductive rights are basic human rights. The United Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade was disgraceful, and it is up to lawmakers to codify Roe, protecting poor and working-class women who will be harmed as a result of this decision."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "87 years of Social Security and the promise hasn’t changed: we will protect retirement benefits so Americans can live their golden years with dignity. Politicians who threaten that are nuts. #SocSec87"

"In Congress, I will always honor our commitments to seniors and protect the Social Security and Medicare programs that they have worked hard to fund. I oppose voucher schemes and support reforms that will ensure appropriate cost of living adjustments that account for the rising costs our seniors face."

"The protection & promise of Social Security is needed more than ever as we stare down a looming retirement crisis. The devastating cuts to this program proposed by @HouseGOP are unacceptable. I will always fight to make sure every American can live their golden years in dignity."
"This guy can't be serious. Somebody please call Senator Ron Johnson and ask why he wants to make America poorer and sicker. Medicare and Social Security must always be protected."

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: "Fair and open elections are the very foundation of our democracy, and I will always fight to strengthen the integrity of our system.I am proud to have the endorsement of @StopBigMoney, a leading organization in the fight to get dark money out of politics! #EndCitizensUnited"
"Unlimited dark money contributions are influencing our elections -- campaign finance shouldn’t be a free-for-all. It’s time to #EndCitizensUnited!"

"We need transparency & accountability in politics. To do this, we must overturn Citizens United. We can't keep letting dark money contaminate our democracy! Proud to have earned support from @StopBigMoney& @usapromise "

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "The #JusticeinPolicing Act would finally allow for meaningful accountability in cases of police misconduct & it would begin the process of reimagining policing in the 21st Century."

"We must seize this moment & keep up the momentum in our country. Last week’s verdict was about accountability. Now, we must continue the fight for JUSTICE & create a future where effective community policing is the norm. #JusticeInPolicing"
Rated 20% by National Association of Police Organizations (NAPO
Voted in favor of HR 1280 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021"

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

"Proud to announce the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) advanced with provisions I authored to enhance ‘Buy American’ standards for major defense acquisition programs to bring manufacturing and high-quality jobs back home."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "Coming together to solve problems and support our neighbors is what South Jersey does best. I was proud to work with state and local partners to secure funding to build Cramer Hill Senior and connect our seniors with affordable housing and accessible health care."

"Everyone deserves a safe, affordable place to call home. This new housing will provide Lawnside families with the foundation they need to #BuildBackBetter, as well as access to public transportation, jobs and quality education."
Voted in favor of HR 7301 "Emergency Housing Protections and Relief Act of 2020"
Voted in favor of HR 8294 "Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2023"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "House Democrats voted to lower gas prices and hold #BigOil accountable a month ago. Senate Republicans, are you going to fight inflation or just talk about it?"

"I'm seeing a lot of politicians go on TV during the workday to complain about inflation. Working families don’t need reminders during their lunch break. It’s time my colleagues come to the table and work with Democrats to lower gas prices and grocery bills."

"If Republicans cared about reducing inflation, they wouldn't whip their caucus to vote against the Inflation Reduction Act. So far, all they've done is fight every single bill we've brought forward that would lower costs for working people. People want solutions, not cheap talk."

"Inflation is down for the 12th straight month. Policies @HouseDemocrats passed last year, like the Inflation Reduction Act, are strengthening our economy and delivering for our communities.I will keep fighting to lower costs for South Jersey families and put #PeopleOverPolitics"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "In New Jersey, the average student loan balance is nearly $40,000. Students need relief now."

"We have made great strides in boosting higher education in South Jersey and making our local universities and county colleges hubs for business innovation and high-tech job creation. I led the charge to strengthen our state’s higher education system and increase opportunities and resources for students at Rutgers-Camden and Rowan Universities, paving the way for a medical sciences research hub in our backyard. Likewise, I worked closely with our local county colleges to forge partnerships that make the transition to our universities easier and more affordable. Now, I’m focused on expanding opportunities for students interested in attending our vocational, technical, and apprenticeship training schools so they can become valued members of our region’s workforce."
Voted in favor of HR 2547 "Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act"

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "Insulin costs are now capped at $35 a month for people on Medicare! This is a huge win for South Jersey families & seniors and is the result of the Inflation Reduction Act, which I was proud to pass last year alongside @HouseDemocrats & @POTUS #PeopleOverPolitics"

"The President promised to negotiate the cost of prescription drugs to save money for American consumers. House Dems passed #HR3 #ForThePeople, which negotiates the cost of prescription drugs & saves money for Americans.The President threatened to veto it. #LowerDrugCostsNow"
"We need to be lowering the cost of prescription drugs – not locking in high prices!"
Voted in favor of HR 3 "Lower Drug Costs Now Act of 2019"
